import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    st=np.sqrt(t); lA=np.log(A); sA=np.sqrt(A)
    return (params[0]*st + params[1]*st*A + params[2]*st*A*lA
            + params[3]*t + params[4]*t*A + params[5]*A + params[6]*A**2
            + params[7]*A*lA + params[8]*t*A*lA + params[9]*t*sA)
